ai.title: Alibaba’s Qwen AI Models Cross 3 Billion Downloads, Surpass Google And Meta In Open-Source AI
ai.description: Alibaba’s Qwen family of open AI models has crossed 3 billion downloads globally in six months, surpassing models from Google, Meta and Chinese rivals. With more than 460 open-source models and 300,000 derivatives, Qwen is emerging as a major foundation for developers building and customizing artificial intelligence applications
ai.title_cn: 阿里巴巴Qwen AI模型下载量突破30亿，超越Google和Meta开源AI
ai.description_cn: 阿里巴巴的Qwen系列开放人工智能模型在六个月内全球下载量突破了30亿次，超过了谷歌、Meta和中国竞争对手的模型。Qwen拥有460多个开源模型和300，000个衍生品，正在成为开发人员构建和定制人工智能应用程序的主要基础

ai.title: Teen charged with murder of mother and brother used ChatGPT to create ‘fantasy stories’ about killing family, officials say
ai.description: A Massachusetts teen charged in the double murder of his mother and younger brother had used the artificial intelligence chatbot ChatGPT to search for “theoretical ideas or fantasy stories” about the killing of his family, prosecutors have said.
